# 实施方案: W29T24

## 任务概述

| 字段 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| Wave | W29 — Integration Tests |
| Task | W29T24 — Compile-fail harness using repository-local fixtures and assertion conventions |
| 目标文件 | `tests/compile_fail_tests.rs` |

## 目标

Compile-fail harness using repository-local fixtures and assertion conventions（不引入 trybuild 等 dev-dep；§4.3 / §8.4）。

本任务实现 W29 集成测试体系中的一个交付物，覆盖 28-tests §5 的测试文件职责、§6 的数值精度与并行/SIMD 规则、§7 的分层执行安排以及 §8 的测试矩阵。核心测试或 fixture 包括：`compile_fail_harness`, `test_collect_compile_fail_cases`, `test_fixture_failure_is_detected`, `test_compile_fail_harness_discovery`, `test_error_token_matches`。

## 前置准备

- 确认 `tests/common` 基础设施或前置测试文件已按依赖完成。
- 使用 28-tests §6.2 定义的精确比较和文档化容差，不随意放宽浮点断言。
- 测试仅验证既有公共 API 和错误语义，不通过测试引入新的产品能力。

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 创建测试文件与导入（harness 通过 `cargo check` 驱动 fixture，能解析 `xenon` crate）

为让 fixture 中的 `use xenon::prelude::*;` 能被解析，**fixture 不是孤立 `.rs` 文件**，而是 workspace `tests/compile-fail/` 下的源码；harness 为每个 fixture 在 `target/compile-fail/<name>/` 下临时写入一个最小 `Cargo.toml`（以 `path = "../../../.."` 指向当前 `xenon` workspace 根），然后调用 `cargo check --manifest-path=... --message-format=json` 驱动该 fixture，并断言 `cargo check` 退出码非零且 stderr 包含 fixture 内 `//~ ERROR: <token>` 注释的 token。

```rust
// tests/compile_fail_tests.rs
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;

const WORKSPACE_REL_FROM_TMP: &str = "../../../..";

struct CompileFailCase {
    name: String,
    path: PathBuf,
    expected_tokens: Vec<String>,
}

impl CompileFailCase {
    /// Parse `//~ ERROR: <token>` annotations from the fixture source.
    fn parse_expected_tokens(src: &str) -> Vec<String> {
        src.lines()
            .filter_map(|l| l.split_once("//~ ERROR:").map(|(_, rest)| rest.trim().to_string()))
            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
            .collect()
    }

    fn from_path(path: PathBuf) -> Self {
        let src = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
            .expect("compile-fail fixture must be readable");
        let name = path.file_stem().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        let expected_tokens = Self::parse_expected_tokens(&src);
        Self { name, path, expected_tokens }
    }

    /// Drive `cargo check` against a fixture using a generated temp crate that depends on `xenon`
    /// by path. This ensures `use xenon::prelude::*;` resolves.
    fn assert_compile_fail(&self) {
        let manifest_dir = std::env::current_dir()
            .expect("cwd must exist")
            .join("target/compile-fail")
            .join(&self.name);
        let src_dir = manifest_dir.join("src");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&src_dir).expect("create temp crate dirs");

        // Copy fixture as main.rs of the temp crate.
        std::fs::copy(&self.path, src_dir.join("main.rs"))
            .expect("copy fixture into temp crate");

        // Minimal Cargo.toml referencing the workspace `xenon` crate by path.
        let cargo_toml = format!(
            r#"[package]
name = "compile_fail_{name}"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"

[[bin]]
name = "compile_fail_{name}"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
xenon = {{ path = "{ws}" }}
"#,
            name = self.name,
            ws = WORKSPACE_REL_FROM_TMP,
        );
        std::fs::write(manifest_dir.join("Cargo.toml"), cargo_toml)
            .expect("write temp Cargo.toml");

        let output = Command::new(env!("CARGO"))
            .args(["check", "--quiet", "--manifest-path"])
            .arg(manifest_dir.join("Cargo.toml"))
            .output()
            .expect("cargo check must be invocable");

        // (1) must NOT compile.
        assert!(
            !output.status.success(),
            "fixture '{}' was expected to fail compilation but succeeded",
            self.name
        );

        // (2) stderr must contain each expected //~ ERROR: <token>.
        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
        for token in &self.expected_tokens {
            assert!(
                stderr.contains(token.as_str()),
                "fixture '{}' stderr did not contain expected token {:?}\nstderr was:\n{}",
                self.name, token, stderr
            );
        }
    }
}

fn collect_compile_fail_cases(root: &Path) -> Vec<CompileFailCase> {
    std::fs::read_dir(root)
        .expect("compile-fail fixture directory must exist")
        .map(|e| e.expect("dir entry").path())
        .filter(|p| p.extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "rs"))
        .map(CompileFailCase::from_path)
        .collect()
}
```

### Step 2: 顶层 harness 测试（§8.4 line 1426-1432）

```rust
#[test]
fn compile_fail_harness() {
    // §8.4 line 1426-1432: drive all fixtures via cargo test.
    let fixtures_dir = Path::new("tests/compile-fail");
    assert!(fixtures_dir.is_dir(), "tests/compile-fail/ must exist");
    let cases = collect_compile_fail_cases(fixtures_dir);
    assert!(!cases.is_empty(), "at least one compile-fail fixture must exist");
    for case in cases {
        case.assert_compile_fail();
    }
}
```

### Step 3: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_collect_compile_fail_cases_filters_rs_files() {
        let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join("xenon_cf_collect");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&tmp).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(tmp.join("a.rs"), "fn main() {}").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(tmp.join("not_rust.txt"), "hello").unwrap();
        let cases = collect_compile_fail_cases(&tmp);
        assert_eq!(cases.len(), 1);
        assert!(cases.iter().all(|c| c.path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "rs")));
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp).ok();
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_error_token_matches() {
        // //~ ERROR: parser must collect tokens.
        let src = "use xenon::prelude::*; //~ ERROR: NotADimension does not implement Dimension\nfn main(){}";
        let tokens = CompileFailCase::parse_expected_tokens(src);
        assert_eq!(tokens, vec!["NotADimension does not implement Dimension".to_string()]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_compile_fail_harness_discovery() {
        // Unconditional: tests/compile-fail/ MUST exist (W29T25 provides the 9 fixtures).
        let fixtures_dir = std::path::Path::new("tests/compile-fail");
        assert!(
            fixtures_dir.is_dir(),
            "tests/compile-fail/ directory must exist (W29T25 deliverable)"
        );
        let cases = collect_compile_fail_cases(fixtures_dir);
        assert!(!cases.is_empty(), "compile-fail fixtures directory must contain .rs files");
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| harness 用 `cargo check`（而非裸 `rustc`）+ 每 fixture 临时 `Cargo.toml` 指向 workspace | 28-tests §8.4 line 1405-1432：通过 `cargo test` 驱动并在测试体调用 `cargo check` 校验预期失败；fixture 中 `use xenon::prelude::*;` 必须能解析 |
| 不引入 `trybuild` / `proptest` / `quickcheck` 等 dev-dep | 28-tests §4.3 line 167-173 |
| 解析 `//~ ERROR: <token>` 注释并对 stderr 做宽松 `contains` 断言 | TEMPLATE 等效验证条款：错误语义必须可机器校验 |
| compile-fail 与运行时错误测试互补 | 28-tests §8.4 line 1443 |

## 验证方式

1. 编译检查: `cargo check --tests`
2. Lint 检查: `cargo clippy --tests -- -D warnings`
3. 测试验证: `cargo test --test compile_fail_tests`
4. 手动验证: 人工审阅失败断言信息，确认 shape、索引、feature 或错误类型上下文足以定位失败原因。

## 注意事项

- 不要用 benchmark 结果替代功能正确性测试；性能验证属于 W28。
- 大张量和高 rank 用例按 28-tests §7/§8 分层执行，避免默认 PR 路径过慢。
- 输出顺序未定义的 API 只能断言集合语义，不得把当前实现顺序写成测试契约。
